text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-runtime-canary` — summary: p50/p95 tail latency spike + increasing 500s on canary cohort c3. alert_id=PD-5821 link=https://pagerduty.example/PD-5821

pagerduty-bot: Escalation step 1: page sent to oncall. Priority: P1. Please acknowledge.

sam_b: Acked. I'm on it.

maya_r: grabbing logs now. can anyone confirm traffic to canary c3?

alex_k: confirmed — c3 at 10% traffic, envoy metrics show 503s starting ~00:21 UTC.

maya_r: putting a quick query: `kubectl -n inference logs -l rollout=canary-c3 --since=15m | grep -E "ERROR|timeout|OOM" | tail -n 50`

maya_r: past 10m: lots of `kv_cache_store: deadline exceeded` and `runtime: out of memory` on worker-3.

sam_b: hmm. memory regression after q3c3 release build. did we change kv cache sizing?

alex_k: patch did bump cached shards + changed jemalloc flags. suspect increased resident set on quantized kernels.

maya_r: short mitigation — can we shift c3 traffic to fallback model variant (v2-stable) and scale up workers?

sam_b: initiating traffic shift to fallback and scaling down canary replicas. running rollback command in prod-control:```sh
# shift traffic away from canary
prodctl rollout traffic set --service inference-runtime --cohort c3 --percent 0 --fallback v2-stable
# scale down problematic pods
kubectl -n inference scale deploy canary-c3 --replicas=0
```

sam_b: command executed, traffic move started. watching metrics.

incident-bot: Action recorded: traffic shift and scale command executed by sam_b.

maya_r: metrics update: 503s dropped to near zero within 30s of shift. p95 latency returning to baseline.

alex_k: good. still want root cause, but immediate customer impact contained.

maya_r: customer impact — found 4 customers with ~10% of requests hitting the canary during spike. IDs: C-4481, C-4492, C-4510, C-4513. All saw transient 500s for ~3m. We should notify support and CS.

sam_b: opened incident ticket INC-2026 and added customer list + preliminary timeline. https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026

tilly_oncall: I'm taking the handoff from sam_b for next hour to monitor and drive postmortem. sam_b — any outstanding runbooks I should follow?

sam_b: noted. runbook: `playbooks/canary-rollback.md` — key steps already executed. check pod memory graphs and heap dumps: `s3://inference-dumps/q3c3/`

maya_r: grabbed heapdump from worker-3, uploading. looks like cache growth didn't trigger GC due to jemalloc config, will share diff.

alex_k: I'll coordinate with runtime team to revert jemalloc flag in the next patch and run a small stress run. planning a stricter canary gating for quantized kernel changes.

pagerduty-bot: Alert PD-5821 status: acknowledged by sam_b, resolved by traffic shift.

tilly_oncall: thanks all. I'm keeping this thread live. moving to watch state for 30m. if no regression, we'll close and schedule postmortem. :thumbsup:

sam_b: excellent. add action items: 1) revert jemalloc flags and run perf tests (alex_k). 2) update canary gate to include memory regression check (maya_r). 3) customer notif draft for CS (tilly_oncall).

maya_r: adding notes to INC-2026 and will upload diff + heapdump links.

tilly_oncall: handing off final watch to alex_k at 1803011400 (30m). I'll update status in ticket then close thread here.

alex_k: I'll take it. ping me if anything else spikes.

incident-bot: Thread state changed to WATCH.

sam_b: :wave: signing off from pager duty for this incident. good job team.
